subject: Follow-up: technical walkthrough missed — options to rebook

Hi Aditi,

We were on for the 2:00 PM walkthrough but it looks like you couldn't make it — hope everything is okay. Marissa (SE) and Karthik (PM) are on standby; we can do one of the following:

- Rebook a full 45–60m technical deep-dive (SE + PM) — suggested slots below.
- Do a 20m recap + recording and then a separate security-focused call with Karthik.
- If you prefer async, I can send the recording and a sandbox invite.

Suggested times (PST):
- Mon 9/18 10:00–11:00
- Tue 9/19 13:30–14:30
- Wed 9/20 09:00–10:00

Attached is the demo agenda we planned (short runbook + checkpoints). If any of those windows work, I’ll lock it and send invites. If none do, tell us your availability and we’ll match.

Quick note: you mentioned on the discovery call that on-prem/KMS was a gating item — Karthik, can you be ready to cover that if Aditi wants a deeper dive?

Thanks,

Jonas Weber
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
[Attachment: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf]

Also, if you can share the short agenda and a sandbox link ahead of time, I’ll loop in our infra lead so they can attend.

—Aditi

1) 5m intros & goals (Aditi + infra lead)
2) 20m product demo — inference runtime, latency/cost controls, routing
3) 10m security + deployment options — on‑prem, VPC, KMS/HSM (Karthik)

I’ll attach the sandbox invite as a small token (link + onboarding steps). Can you share your infra lead’s email so I can add them to the calendar invite?
